Client.hero_subtitle: I build things for the web.
Client.hero_text: Fullstack engineer with 5+ years of experience building production web applications with React, Next.js and Node.js. I turn designs into fast, polished interfaces and take features from Figma all the way to production.
Client.expertise_web_subtitle: Modern web applications from architecture to production
Client.expertise_web_text: Crafting interactive and dynamic user interfaces with React, ensuring clean, maintainable, and well-organized code.
Client.expertise_ui_text: Crafting visually engaging, user-centered interfaces for seamless, accessible experiences.
Client.expertise_animation_subtitle: Adding depth through smooth transitions and animations
Client.expertise_animation_text: Bringing interfaces to life with engaging animations and transitions.
Client.expertise_responsive_text: Building layouts and components that look and perform beautifully on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.
Client.expertise_api_text: Integrating REST and GraphQL APIs, connecting third-party services, and handling data mapping and edge cases.
Client.expertise_backend_subtitle: The data, content and logic behind the interface
Client.expertise_backend_text: Building and maintaining APIs with Node.js, working with CMS platforms and data models, and connecting the backend to the front end.
Client.work_freelance_text: Planned and built the front-end part completely from scratch. Implemented smooth transitions and animation of components. Maintained admin panel in Payload CMS.
Client.work_hxm_text: Worked on the front- and back-end architectures of Next.js/TypeScript projects, building reusable components, animations, and maintaining Payload CMS. Integrated GraphQL, Google Maps, and Spotify APIs, etc and handling everything from API data to adding UI animations, improving performance, and code reviews.
Client.work_eliftech_text: Contributed to the development of the fintech app, helping users achieve financial goals through features like a sleek, intuitive Wishlist tool for budgeting and planning. Worked on a paragliding social network, building key interfaces and features such as User Profiles, Reviews, and Complaints & Suggestions, while ensuring a user-friendly experience with real-time weather updates and event tracking.
Client.work_custom4web_text: Developed, maintained, and shipped production code for client websites primarily using Vue, HTML, CSS, Sass, JavaScript, and jQuery
Client.work_triplefork_text: Developed, maintained, and shipped production code for client websites primarily using HTML, CSS, Sass, JavaScript, and jQuery
Client.project_art_center_text: Editorial hub for an art space's ongoing program — articles, events, and new releases — recognized with an Awwwards Honorable Mention.
Client.project_art_center_detail: Helped to build site's page-transition and component system.
Client.project_music_award_text: Digital home of the Icelandic Music Awards — an annual celebration of the country's music industry — rebuilt with a fresh, CMS-driven front end.
Client.project_music_award_detail: Built the majority of the site's screens and components, then led the migration of the front end onto Prismic as a headless CMS — giving the client full editorial control without touching code.
Client.project_viska_text: Dual-vendor site search shipped solo — Cludo powers hero and site-wide search.
Client.project_viska_block1_text: Indexed the client's content and integrated Cludo's site-wide search API from scratch as the solo developer on this feature, building the hooks, state, and actions layer everything else is built on.
Client.project_viska_block2_text: Built out a full component hierarchy on top of that data layer to cover every place search needed to live: a hero search, a dedicated search section, and a compact variant embedded in articles and search results.
Client.project_viska_block3_text: The whole flow — hero search, section, and compact search — is fully responsive, holding up just as well on mobile.
Client.project_nattura_text: Catalogue of Iceland's protected nature areas and national parks, anchored by a fully custom-built interactive map
Client.project_nattura_block1_text: Among others, designed and built a custom interactive map of protected areas and national parks from scratch, wired directly into Payload CMS content — no third-party map library.
Client.project_si_text: Migrating a legacy Java system onto a modern Payload-powered stack.
Client.project_si_block1_text: Integrating two external Azure Logic App REST endpoints for live membership and craftsman data.
Client.about_main_text:
Hi there!
You’ve probably figured out by now that I’m a Web Developer who’s passionate about crafting smooth, responsive, and visually engaging web experiences. I love blending creativity with code, making sure every pixel is in its place while keeping performance top-notch. I’ve been doing this for almost 3 years now, and it never gets old.
Client.about_honorable_mention: One of the projects I had the chance to contribute to even earned an Honorable Mention on Awwwards—which was a pretty cool moment!
